schema.content:
Table "Addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "address_details" TEXT
}

Table "Customer_Addresses" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Customer_Orders" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_status_code" TEXT [not null]
  "order_date" TIMESTAMP [not null]
}

Table "Customers" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "payment_method_code" TEXT [not null]
  "customer_code" TEXT
  "customer_name" TEXT
  "customer_address" TEXT
  "customer_phone" TEXT
  "customer_email" TEXT
}

Table "Department_Store_Chain" {
  "dept_store_chain_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "dept_store_chain_name" TEXT
}

Table "Department_Stores" {
  "dept_store_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "dept_store_chain_id" INTEGER
  "store_name" TEXT
  "store_address" TEXT
  "store_phone" TEXT
  "store_email" TEXT
}

Table "Departments" {
  "department_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "dept_store_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "department_name" TEXT
}

Table "Order_Items" {
  "order_item_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Product_Suppliers" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "supplier_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_supplied_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_supplied_to" TIMESTAMP
  "total_amount_purchased" TEXT
  "total_value_purchased" TEXT
}

Table "Products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "product_name" TEXT
  "product_price" TEXT
}

Table "Staff" {
  "staff_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "staff_gender" TEXT
  "staff_name" TEXT
}

Table "Staff_Department_Assignments" {
  "staff_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "department_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_assigned_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "job_title_code" TEXT [not null]
  "date_assigned_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Supplier_Addresses" {
  "supplier_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "date_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Suppliers" {
  "supplier_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "supplier_name" TEXT
  "supplier_phone" TEXT
}
